title: Folder view should not allow duplicated file deletion dialog
line: Pressing Delete again on the desktop while a delete confirmation is open no longer opens a second confirmation dialog.
explanation: Folder View starts a KIO DeleteOrTrashJob for every Delete, Shift+Delete or Empty Trash request. Its confirmation dialog can't be modal to the QML desktop (KIO only takes a QWidget parent), so the desktop kept accepting input and each new request opened another dialog. FolderModel now remembers the job whose confirmation is open (until it reports started or finishes) and ignores further delete, trash or empty-trash requests meanwhile.

commits.message:
folder: don't open a second delete confirmation dialog

Deleting or trashing with confirmation opened a new dialog each time,
because it can't be modal to the desktop. Now further delete, trash or
empty trash requests are ignored while a confirmation is still open.

BUG: 387988

media.caption: Master: folder selected, Shift+Delete, then clicked the folder again and Shift+Delete again: two Delete Permanently dialogs.
With the fix, same steps: the second Shift+Delete reaches the desktop but only the first dialog stays open.
